correctness.rationale: Exact Laplacian eigenbasis gives K=m[A/x+D/(x+ry)]. Matrix trace-inverse strict convexity guarantees global unique optimum over all edge variables. The scalar t=z/x objective has derivative beta*A-alpha*D/t² and the identity A+D=mr² gives the sharp support threshold including equality. Rational verifier passes 522 checks, of which 360 are arbitrary asymmetric competitors. The corollary comparing spoke-only and optimal designs follows by taking the exact b-to-zero limit of the optimal value.

value.rationale: The explicit optimal priced allocation and universal threshold b/a=2N/(N-1) classify when intra-community conductance has zero versus strictly positive investment for a natural infinite network family. This is not obtained merely by evaluating a fixed-weight graph index; the exact support phase boundary and its independence from clique decomposition are useful design information. In the low-internal-edge-price limit, the spoke-only design incurs a provably unbounded penalty as clique size grows; thus the threshold can have substantial consequences.
